name: Giddy Up: walking on foot uses Sprint (on foot, out of combat, Sprint ready, ~60 y open ground ahead)

steps.msg: start on foot, out of combat
no Sprint/Peloton left over from earlier
the on-foot watcher should run with Auto Sprint on
Giddy Up should use Sprint once you've been moving a moment
no wait for an effect should be left hanging
no Peloton on top of a fresh Sprint (Sprint is faster)
the Sprint press should go through the first time (no other action at the same moment)
